$comment: All supported catalog groups are installed by setup from the pinned package-lock.json. Manage with the launcher (p) or: npm run plugins -- list | install <group|package…> | ensure | verify. Excluded packages are incompatible alternatives.

packages.name: @remotion/renderer
packages.desc: Render videos from Node — used by the render pipeline

packages.name: @remotion/zod-types
packages.desc: Color pickers etc. in the props editor

packages.name: @remotion/animation-utils
packages.desc: Interpolate colors, transforms and CSS styles

packages.name: @remotion/fonts
packages.desc: Load local brand fonts (.woff2/.otf) from public/

packages.name: @remotion/paths
packages.desc: SVG path drawing, morphing, stroke reveal

packages.name: @remotion/preload
packages.desc: Preload assets for smooth Studio preview

packages.name: @remotion/sfx
packages.desc: Built-in sound effects library (whooshes, clicks, pops)

packages.name: @remotion/mac-cursors
packages.desc: macOS cursors for app walkthrough demos

packages.name: @remotion/install-whisper-cpp
packages.desc: Local Whisper.cpp transcription → word-level captions (downloads a model on first use)

packages.name: @remotion/whisper-webgpu
packages.desc: Transcribe in the browser via WebGPU

packages.name: @remotion/whisper-web
packages.desc: Transcribe in the browser via WASM

packages.desc: Drive GSAP timelines from the Remotion frame

packages.name: @remotion/three
packages.desc: React Three Fiber 3D scenes (3D phone mockups)
